name: Hougetsu Ruby
source:
An "ara ara, ufufu" mom who's an active mahou shoujo.

Publicly, she's a mother of one who works as a part-time school nurse.

After losing her husband at a young age, she raised her daughter Aqua on her own and has built a good relationship with her.

However, her true identity is a mahou shoujo from another world.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/mahou/index.html#CHARACTER]official website[/url]]
